attchmntText: SRM Contractors Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: SRM Contractors Limited filed an investor presentation for Q2 and H1 FY27. The company reported revenue from operations of Rs 304 crore for the quarter, with EBITDA at Rs 59 crore and PAT at Rs 30 crore. For the half year, revenue was Rs 500 crore, EBITDA was Rs 98 crore, and PAT was Rs 50 crore. The consolidated order book stood at approximately Rs 2556 crore as of September 2026. The company secured EPC orders worth approximately Rs 1150 crore, including Rs 483 crore from MSIDC and Rs 128 crore from NHAI. SRM Contractors formed a 49:51 joint venture with Giraffe for highway-side amenities. CARE Ratings reaffirmed the company's long-term rating as CARE A with a Stable outlook.

attchmntText: SRM Contractors Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: SRM Contractors Limited has filed an intimation regarding the publication of its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The company published these results in the Financial Express newspaper in English and the Hind Samachar newspaper in Urdu. This filing is made pursuant to Regulations 30 and 47 read with Schedule II of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The intimation was signed by Arun Mathur, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, on 16th November 2026.

attchmntText: SRM Contractors Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: SRM Contractors Limited filed its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results during a meeting on 14 November 2026. For the half year ended 30 September 2026, revenue from operations was 40,783.10 lakhs. Profit after tax stood at 3,900.89 lakhs. Earnings per equity share were 17.00. Total assets as at 30 September 2026 were 76,078.03 lakhs. The independent auditor issued a review report stating nothing came to their attention indicating material misstatement. The results are available on the company website.

attchmntText: SRM Contractors Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 26, 2026, titled "Bagging of Contract - Intimation under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.".
